title: A House for the Cellar
author: Ansel Halloran
blurb: Noor Sandoval, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
